checked.item: "Configure / Set up matching" entry button — is it obvious this opens the matching rules?
"Update" button — does it save immediately, and would I know if it failed?
"Close without saving" (×) — would closing lose work I haven't noticed I made?
Discard-changes dialog — "Discard your changes?" wording and whether it reassures me my saved rules are untouched
"Use default matching rules" vs "Use custom rules" — do I understand what each does before picking one?
"Customer matches the payment's customer" checkbox — plain enough, or does turning it off feel risky?
Locked "Invoice date is within ... days" checkbox with lock icon — do I know why it's locked and what to do about it?
Invoice-number match row — source select, comparison select, and the "Invoice number in books (DocNumber)" label
"Which Stripe field holds the reference" text input — is it obvious this is required, and do I know what to type?
"+ Add condition" / refine rows with AND/OR join word — could I tell what combining rows does?
"Apply as overpayment" switch — do I understand the consequence of on vs off?
"Cancel sync if there is no matching open invoice found for a payment" switch and its description mentioning another page and "Sales Receipt"
Error alert on Update with a required field empty — when do I first learn a field is required?

findings.element: "Which Stripe field holds the reference" input (shown when a metadata source is picked)
findings.finding: Nothing on screen marks this field as required while I'm filling out the form — I only find out it's mandatory after I press Update and get blocked.
findings.user_impact: I think I've finished setting up my rule, click Update expecting it to save, and instead get an error — after already abandoning 3 tools over setup friction, this is exactly the kind of surprise that makes me close the tab.
findings.suggested_fix: Show a "Required" hint or asterisk on this field the moment I pick Invoice metadata or Payment metadata as the source, not only after Update fails.

evidence.quote: 1 thing to fix before this can be saved — the Stripe field name is missing.

findings.element: "Cancel sync if there is no matching open invoice found for a payment" switch description
findings.finding: The description tells me flipping this switch changes something on a different page too, but doesn't say whether that's safe, reversible, or already applied.
findings.user_impact: I worry that touching this toggle changes settings somewhere else I can't see right now, so I leave it alone rather than risk breaking something on a page I'm not even looking at.
findings.suggested_fix: Add a short reassurance next to the switch, e.g. "This is the same setting shown on Get & Send Payments — you can change it back any time."

evidence.quote: Same setting as Get & Send Payments — changing it here updates that page.

findings.element: Invoice-number match row, description text next to the comparison dropdown
findings.finding: "DocNumber" is QuickBooks' internal field name and isn't something I'd recognize as my everyday invoice number.
findings.user_impact: I second-guess whether this row touches the invoice numbers I actually use or some hidden system field, and hesitate before trusting this row of the rule.
findings.suggested_fix: Drop the parenthetical for a first-timer, or add a one-line tooltip: "This is the invoice number you already use in QuickBooks."

gaps: overlay chrome / Update: a clean, error-free save was never exercised in this recon, so whether a persistent "saved" signal appears afterward is unknown — this bears directly on the known friction of users re-opening the panel just to check if their change stuck.

overlay chrome / Close without saving: only the with-unsaved-changes path (discard prompt) was exercised; closing with no pending changes was not, so I can't confirm it closes without any confirmation friction.
